title: Reverse Linked List II
statement:
Given the head of a singly linked list and two integers `left` and `right` where left <= right, reverse the nodes of the list from position `left` to position `right`, and return the reversed list.

The positions are 1-indexed.
inputFormat:
Line 1: three integers N, `left`, and `right`.
Line 2: N space-separated integers for list values.
outputFormat: N space-separated integers representing the resulting list.

examples.explanation: Reverse from 1 to 1 leaves it the same.

starterCode.python:
n, left, right = map(int, input().split())
a = list(map(int, input().split()))
